white_box_upgrade.role: qualified high-ticket upgrade after a named human outcome, not the first SKU

gate.pack_meaning: four named human-outcome SKUs exist with scope, price, acceptance, refund, intake, and founder-sent contact; not bank cash

offers.name: Named issue to a CI-green PR
offers.human_pain: A named public repo issue sits open. The buyer needs one merged pull request that closes it with green CI on the merged SHA.
offers.scope: one named issue on one named public repository; one pull request; CI green on the integrated SHA; issue closed by that PR
acceptance: issue number named in the SOW
PR merged to the repository default branch
CI green on the integrated SHA
issue closed with the PR as the closer
offers.refund: If work never starts after written intake, founder refunds the authorized amount. If CI never greens or the PR never merges, the second half is withheld. A style disagreement is not a refund.
out_of_scope: secret or private repos unless the buyer opens a public twin
auth, login, or permission gates added to Commons
falsifier: CI red on the integrated SHA

offers.name: Accessible public-meeting packet
offers.human_pain: A public meeting is on the calendar. The buyer needs a readable packet, not a Slack dump or a login wall.
offers.scope: one named public meeting; one packet (HTML plus printable); agenda, one-page brief, source list; no login to read
acceptance: every claim cites a public source or is marked UNMEASURED
offers.refund: If the packet is not delivered before the named meeting date because the provider missed the clock, founder refunds. Buyer-late inputs move the clock. A policy disagreement is not a refund.
out_of_scope: speaking for the buyer at the meeting
private attendee lists on public roads

offers.name: Security questionnaire completion
offers.human_pain: A vendor security questionnaire is blocking a sale or partnership. Empty cells stall a human, not a proof ritual.
offers.scope: one named questionnaire; every answer cites a public path or UNMEASURED; no invented certification; returned as a filled copy
acceptance: every required cell filled or marked UNMEASURED
no CMMC / ITAR / defense-ready claim invented
filled copy returned to the founder-sent contact
offers.refund: If the filled copy is not returned in 10 days after complete inputs, founder refunds. Missing buyer attachments move the clock. A failed third-party audit is not this SKU and not a refund of a completed questionnaire.
out_of_scope: CMMC, FedRAMP, SOC2, ITAR, or any certification stamp
storing credentials or private buyer answers on Commons
falsifier: blank required cells with no UNMEASURED mark
credentials pasted onto a public road

offers.name: 8-bit / pixel agent pack
offers.human_pain: The buyer wants a visible little dude that walks and speaks, not another proof essay.
offers.scope: one sprite, one walk loop, one speak line wired to a public post id on the existing 8bit door or a linked public page
acceptance: speak line cites a public p/{id}.md
static frame readable with JS off
offers.refund: If no sprite lands on the named public page in 5 days after intake, founder refunds. Art-direction churn after acceptance is a change order.
falsifier: speak line cites a bake instead of p/{id}.md
